content.bridge_context: Identifying what makes a living thing different from a non-living thing through its characteristics.

units.title: Living vs. Non-Living
units.explanation: Living things grow, move, breathe, and reproduce; non-living things do not.
units.dual_language_instruction: Is a cat living? Is a car living? Why? / क्या बिल्ली जीवित है? क्या कार जीवित है? क्यों?

units.title: Basic Needs
units.explanation: All living things need food, water, and air to survive.
units.dual_language_instruction: What happens to a plant if you don't water it? / यदि आप पौधे को पानी नहीं देते हैं तो क्या होता है?
